authority: User explicitly approved one bounded mixed-launcher read after implementation and independent review, only to project aes_core/spi submission order and Job IDs. No job operation, training, other-circuit status, quality or runtime output is authorized.
reader: Python 3.6-compatible stdlib. Descriptor-relative O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW ancestor chain; fixed ordinary single-link regular file, no reparse-equivalent attributes; full stable pre/path/open/fd/post identity and byte count. No directory listing, procfs alias, fallback path, referenced-file access, target import or execution. Read at most 2 MiB of mixed log bytes; never decode arbitrary lines. No full mixed-input digest is exported.
header_grammar: Full physical LF line, optional CRLF: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS followed by Z or signed HH:MM timezone, TAB known circuit, TAB CLOSURE TAB SUBMIT. Numeric ranges validate shape, not calendar authenticity. Known circuits are the frozen wrapper literals b20,b21,b22,wb_dma,aes_core,tv80,spi, handled as bytes. Only aes_core and spi SUBMIT create output rows. ANY line containing TAB or starting with a datelike YYYY-MM-DD prefix clears prior context first, even malformed or unknown progress. Warnings may therefore conservatively produce MISSING rather than inferred association.
job_grammar: Exact full physical line: Job <1-20 ASCII decimal digits> is submitted to (default )?queue <1-64 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/dot/hyphen>. Job digits are preserved as strings including leading zeroes. Job lines outside an active target block are ignored. First Job line gives UNIQUE; any additional matching Job line in that block yields AMBIGUOUS and null job_id, never selecting one.
projection: Preserve every target SUBMIT in encountered order, including repeated submissions. order is target-only 1..N, not a physical or global log ordinal. Only circuit literal, order, job_id or null, and association UNIQUE/MISSING/AMBIGUOUS are exported per row. No timestamps, non-target circuit names/counts/status/IDs, raw lines, queue names, quality or runtime values. At most 16 target rows; overflow fails closed, not truncated.
status_policy: No target rows: NO_MATCH_WITHIN_FIXED_SCOPE, never global absence. PASS_TARGET_SUBMISSION_METADATA_OBSERVATIONS requires both requested targets present and every preserved row UNIQUE. Otherwise PARTIAL_TARGET_SUBMISSION_METADATA. All association is LOG_ORDER_ONLY_NOT_EXECUTION_PROOF: text order does not certify circuit causality, current job state, actual execution, complete cost lineage or historical freeze.
transport_policy: Fixed ssh -T -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 vnc.buptic.top '/usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B -'. Explicit reviewed producer SHA checked before SSH. Only create-once runtime_training_staging_20260928/v6_e64_submission_metadata_* local receipts. Bounded concurrent streams and 60 s timeout. Require exit0, empty stderr and no timeout/overflow/write failure plus exact response validator. Source loaded by fixed absolute sibling importlib path. No automatic retry and no claim of verified remote termination.
failure: Fixed redacted FAIL_CLOSED_SUBMISSION_METADATA / FIXED_SOURCE_REJECTED packet only, no exception text or log content.
validation: Exact top-level and row keys; fixed path/evidence, numeric byte/resource bounds, strict row order/target/Job shape and association/null consistency, derived status, all non-target/quality/runtime/history/job-execution/physical-call/cost/train flags false. Duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard constants rejected.
tests: 12 synthetic tests: private binary sentinels, non-target and malformed progress boundaries, missing/duplicate/repeated submissions, LF/CRLF/full-line grammar, one-target partial/no-match, FD bounds/symlink/link/mutation and close-once, strict schema/false flags, isolated sibling validator, one-shot fake SSH success/failure/timeout/overflow/source pin. No actual SSH, payload main or inspected launcher read by worker.
actual_execution_gate: Independent source/test review and parent authority gate before exactly one fixed-path attempt. No new file, directory, mixed log, job query/submission, deployment, runtime read or training authority inferred. No adaptive retry on unsupported content.
